companies.name: アマゾン・ドット・コム(AWS)

relations.text: 取引所などのシステムをAWSのクラウドへ移行する提携を進めている
relations.text_en: Nasdaq is migrating its exchanges and non-exchange workloads to the cloud through its partnership with AWS

source.label: ナスダック 10-K(2025年12月期)
source.quote: We believe that migrating our exchanges and non-exchange workloads to the cloud, through our partnership with AWS, will result in improved performance and increased flexibility for our customers.

relations.text: 取引所サービスの提供にAWSの基盤を使っている
relations.text_en: Nasdaq uses an AWS platform to provide exchange and other services to its clients

source.label: ナスダック 10-K(2025年12月期)
source.quote: AWS operates a plat form that we use to provide exchange and other services to our clients, and therefore we are vulnerable to service outages on the AWS platform that affect Nasdaq workloads running or stored in the AWS environment.

companies.name: Cboeグローバル・マーケッツ

relations.text: 米国のオプション市場でCboeの取引所と競合している
relations.text_en: Nasdaq's U.S. options markets compete with exchanges operated by Cboe

source.label: ナスダック 10-K(2025年12月期)
source.quote: In the U.S., our options markets compete with exchanges operated by Cboe Global Markets, Inc., or CBOE , Miami International Holdings, Inc., or MIAX, Intercontinental Exchange , Inc., or ICE, Members Exchange, or MEMX, and BOX Options Market.

companies.name: インターコンチネンタル取引所

relations.text: 米国の現物株式市場でICEの取引所と競合している
relations.text_en: Nasdaq's U.S. cash equities markets compete with exchanges operated by ICE

source.label: ナスダック 10-K(2025年12月期)
source.quote: In the U.S., our cash equities markets 9 compete with exchanges operated by Cboe, ICE, MIAX, the TXSE Group , The Investors Exchange, MEMX and Long Term Stock Exchange.

source.label: ナスダック 10-K(2025年12月期)
source.quote: In the U.S., our options markets compete with exchanges operated by Cboe Global Markets, Inc., or CBOE , Miami International Holdings, Inc., or MIAX, Intercontinental Exchange , Inc., or ICE, Members Exchange, or MEMX, and BOX Options Market.

relations.text: 欧州の上場誘致で、ドイツ取引所などの取引所と競合している
relations.text_en: Competing European exchanges for listings include Deutsche Börse AG

source.label: ナスダック 10-K(2025年12月期)
source.quote: For those considering an alternative, competing European exchanges that frequently attract many listings from outside their respective home countries include LSE, Euronext N.V. and Deutsche Börse AG.
